local.decisionRule: One pooled1000, <50% futility at300/500, final>=55%; no retries/tuning/early pass.

process.timingCaveat: Response latency includes host IO/scheduling; local readiness is not CG timing assurance.

boss.interpretation: Practical score filter on reused known maps; no claim of statistical improvement.
limitations: Unchanged public boss/league IDs do not prove unchanged hidden boss implementation or execution conditions.
Known map/control outcomes can influence development; this panel is not fresh confirmation.

paint.kind: descriptive first20 and full-game actual CG paint/warnings
limitations: V7 versus selected v09 does not establish head-to-head superiority over V6.
The fresh V7 boss pool differs from historical V6 boss and arena maps/opponents; paint or win-rate differences are not paired V7-vs-V6 improvements.
Accepted paint is descriptive; spending all 3 is not proof of useful construction, and short paint/wall warnings do not identify abort phases or server timeouts.
The gate promotion flag expresses eligibility only; current/default remains v09 and no arena publication or promotion was performed.
The local phase archive remains immutable; the separate live archive retains public eighty-game continuation evidence.
